thread:
elaine: @here Quick GA push note — Stable Streaming v1.2 is scheduled to reach hosted production today at 17:00 PT. Major items: adaptive-region routing enabled by default, tool-calling semantic formalization (safer webhook handling), and consolidated streaming runtime optimizations. Docs & changelog: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/stable-streaming-1-2 :tada:
chris: Nice. Any breaking changes customers should expect?
elaine: No breaking changes for basic streaming usage. Tool-calling helpers are new (JS/Python SDKs bump to 0.13.x). Legacy streaming endpoints remain available under /v1/streams/legacy for a 90-day migration window.
ops-bot: Deployment plan: 17:00-18:30 PT. Rollout order: us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. Health checks and canary keys in use.
marco: Dedicated customers: check the "routing policy" toggle if you pin model variants, otherwise adaptive routing won't override pins. We'll email affected contacts with instructions.
elaine: Also introducing a default concurrent stream limit: 60 streams/org (reduce noisy neighbors). Support can raise limits per contract.
eng_prod: Migration checklist (draft): [1] Upgrade SDKs in staging to 0.13.x, [2] Validate tool-call flows with staging webhooks, [3] Canary region routing via canary keys, [4] Run load tests and monitor fallback-count metric. I'll post a link to the checklist doc shortly.
chris: Observability changes? Will Console expose stream-region breakdown?
elaine: Yes: Console now has a "Streaming" view with per-region p50/p95/p99, token-level cost, and fallback-count (how often routing falls back to alternate region/model).
ops-bot: SRE note: burn-in job running during rollout to exercise KV-cache interactions. Rollout auto-pauses if streaming-err-rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 350ms.
marco: For customers using functions with external webhooks: any config changes?
elaine: Ensure callback domains are whitelisted in the new tool-calling config. We added stricter validation to avoid webhook abuse.
chris: Example curl for the new streaming tool-calling flow (for docs):
chris: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model": "redwood-stable-1.2", "tools": [{"name":"weather","url":"https://hooks.example.com/weather"}], "stream": true}'
```
elaine: If you hit issues during the window ping #eng-oncall and tag @ops-bot. We'll open a post-mortem thread in #product for any user-impacting issues.
cto_jane: Great work. Please prepare an exec digest tomorrow summarizing SLA impact this week. :eyes:
